title: Steal a Superpower Codes (November 2026) & How to Redeem
description: Copy reported Steal a Superpower codes for Roblox, check pack and potion rewards, and follow redemption steps with dated sources and in-game claim checks.

hero.heading: Steal a Superpower Codes
hero.lead: Find Steal a Superpower codes reported by gaming guides, copy a code, then redeem it inside Roblox. Source reports checked November 5, 2026; these codes have not been tested in-game by this site.

sections.heading: Reported Steal a Superpower Codes
paragraphs: The list below records third-party reports, not a guarantee of current validity. Roblox Den listed seven codes on November 5; Pro Game Guides listed five on November 4. Different publication dates and coverage can produce different lists.

If you are searching for working Steal a Superpower codes, use the dated list as a starting point and let the game confirm each result. Copying a string preserves its spelling; it does not verify that the reward is still available.

sections.heading: How to Redeem Steal a Superpower Codes
paragraphs: Roblox Den and Pro Game Guides both describe the same redemption flow. Enter codes inside the experience, rather than on this website.

steps.heading: Launch the game
steps.description: Open Steal a Superpower through the official Roblox game page listed in Sources.

steps.heading: Open Codes
steps.description: Select the Codes button at the top right of the game screen.

steps.heading: Enter and redeem
steps.description: Paste the code into the entry box and select Redeem. Read the in-game response to confirm whether a reward was granted.

sections.heading: Why Might a Code Not Work?
paragraphs: Copy the spelling and capitalization as shown, and remove any spaces introduced before or after the code. Then read the response in the game. A report from a guide cannot override that response.

If the game says a code is expired or already redeemed, use that message to decide your next step. A failed claim alone does not tell this site that every player will see the same result. We do not label a code expired without supporting evidence.

subsections.heading: Check the Entered String
paragraphs: Use the Copy button, paste into the game, and check for leading or trailing spaces. Roblox Den labels its codes case-sensitive, so preserve the capitalization as reported rather than changing it. This is a precaution based on that source, not a claim that this site tested the redemption engine.

subsections.heading: Read the Response Before Trying Again
paragraphs: Expiration, a previously redeemed claim, a typo or a change after an update are possible explanations for a failure. They are troubleshooting possibilities, not diagnoses of an individual code. Keep the exact response if you want to compare a report with what your account sees.

sections.heading: What Rewards Are Reported?
paragraphs: The reported rewards include Luck Potions, Power Potions and a Legend Pack. Potion names are recorded as published; no duration, multiplier or drop-rate effect is promised here. A pack and a potion are different rewards.

links.description: See how packs connect to power cards and other acquisition routes.

sections.heading: Where to Check for New Codes
paragraphs: Start with the official game page and follow developer community links from Roblox. Check the game description and current announcements after updates. Source dates on this page show when the reports were reviewed, not when we successfully redeemed a code.
We have no game-tested expired-code list as of the review date. This does not mean every reported code is still available.

sections.heading: Code Source Review Log
paragraphs: November 5, 2026: this page records the seven entries visible in Roblox Den’s dated report. Pro Game Guides’ November 4 list contains five entries, while Destructoid’s November 4 report lists 20KLIKES. Those differences are preserved as source coverage differences; omission from one article is not proof that a code expired.

The dates describe published reports and this page’s source review. There is no first-person redemption timestamp to report. A future revision should update a code’s status only with supporting evidence rather than automatically treating every older entry as expired.

faq.question: Where is the Codes button?
faq.answer: The media redemption guides place it at the top right of the game screen. Enter the code there and press Redeem.

faq.question: Are these codes tested by this site?
faq.answer: No. They are media-reported codes with a source and a review date. The game determines whether each claim succeeds.

faq.question: Does DISCORD give a Legend Pack?
faq.answer: Roblox Den and Pro Game Guides report a Legend Pack for DISCORD. Availability is not guaranteed; confirm the redemption response in-game.

faq.question: How do you redeem Steal a Superpower Roblox codes?
faq.answer: Open the game on Roblox, select Codes at the top right, paste the exact string and press Redeem. The game’s response confirms whether your account received a reward.

faq.question: Are Steal a Superpower codes case-sensitive?
faq.answer: Roblox Den labels its listed codes case-sensitive. Preserve the exact characters when copying. This site has not independently tested capitalization behavior.

faq.question: Are all reported codes still active?

title: Steal a Superpower Powers: Cards, Types & Leveling
description: Explore Steal a Superpower powers, ability cards and leveling. Learn the named types, Ancient-card reference and Index rewards, without invented tiers.

hero.heading: Steal a Superpower Powers Guide
hero.lead: Steal a Superpower powers come through collectible cards with their own moves. The developer description names seven categories and says leveling a card unlocks its most powerful ability.

sections.heading: Confirmed Power Types in Steal a Superpower
paragraphs: The named categories are lightning, fire, frost, gravity, time, shadow and gold. They describe powers mentioned in the game description, rather than a complete card catalog or a strength ranking.

sections.heading: How Power Cards and Moves Work
paragraphs: A card has its own set of moves. The useful distinction is between collecting a power and developing the card that carries it: getting a card introduces a moveset, while card leveling opens its strongest ability.
Read the moves shown on your actual card before comparing it with another. Category names alone do not establish range, damage, cooldown or usefulness in a particular fight.

subsections.heading: Getting Cards from Ability Packs
paragraphs: Ability packs are the source of collectible power cards in the description. Opening another pack contributes to your collection; it does not by itself say that an existing card leveled up. Keep the new-card result and the current card’s progression separate when checking what changed.

subsections.heading: A Moveset Belongs to a Card
paragraphs: The description gives every card its own set of moves. Two category names alone cannot settle which moves are available to your character. Look at the actual card you are using, including what it has already unlocked, before planning your next fight.

sections.heading: Leveling Your Power Cards
paragraphs: The developer description explicitly connects card levels to unlocking an ability. It does not supply a universal experience requirement, level cap or exact upgrade cost. Use the card information displayed in your current game version for those details.

A practical check before a boss attempt is to review which moves your equipped card has already unlocked. This is a preparation suggestion based on the leveling mechanic, not a claim that any particular card wins the fight.

sections.heading: Using Powers in Combat
paragraphs: Powers are used against enemies as you fight through zones and approach Dominus bosses. The description says the world breaks apart around you during combat. That describes the environment; it does not establish a special damage bonus for breaking a particular wall or object.

For a useful combat comparison, keep the card and its level visible in your notes. Record the moves you can use and which boss or zone you are trying to reach. If a result changes after several upgrades at once, you cannot reliably attribute that improvement to the power category alone. This is a comparison method, not a claim of a tested build.

links.label: See where card preparation fits into boss progression

sections.heading: Ancient Cards and Rarities
paragraphs: The developer description asks whether you can pull an Ancient card. Ancient is therefore a named collection reference, rather than a rarity label inferred from the color of a screenshot. The same description links completing the Index to permanent rewards for collected rarities.

These are two different pieces of information: Ancient is mentioned as a card you might pull, while the Index tracks collection progress across rarities. Neither statement provides an exhaustive rarity ladder, a guarantee of the strongest card, or a pull percentage.

subsections.heading: What Is Confirmed About Ancient Cards
paragraphs: Ancient cards are explicitly mentioned by the creator. The source does not give their individual names, full movesets, acquisition odds or damage. An Ancient label should not be converted into an invented S-tier recommendation.

subsections.heading: Index Rewards and Collection Progress
paragraphs: Use the Index shown in your game to see which collection entries or rarity rewards you have obtained. Keep the reward display separate from the card’s level: collecting a rarity and unlocking a card move are different forms of progress.

links.label: Return to the game and collection overview

sections.heading: Cards in Your Base
paragraphs: Cards also have an economic role. The description says cards placed on base holders earn cash while you fight. This connects your collection to base growth as well as combat.

When deciding what to do next, distinguish the card you are using for moves from the cards you want producing cash on holders. Inspect the game UI for actual income figures; no income rate is inferred from a category name.

sections.heading: Getting More Powers
paragraphs: Ability packs are the collection route described for power cards. Boss-related rewards and the advertised Legend Pack group offer connect back to that pack-opening loop.

sections.heading: How to Read a Power Comparison
paragraphs: Compare the actual card, its current level and its available moves in the game. Those observations are more useful than treating an elemental name as a tier.
This page does not assign S/A/B grades or name a best card. The cited description establishes the categories and upgrade system, but does not establish a measured ranking.

subsections.heading: Is There a Best Power?
paragraphs: A reliable best-power recommendation needs an identified card, a level, available moves and the situation being compared. The source description supplies the category names and progression system, but no measured comparison. Use those concrete fields when evaluating a recommendation you find elsewhere.

subsections.heading: What to Record When Comparing Cards
paragraphs: Record the card name displayed in-game, its category if shown, its level, unlocked moves and the task you tested. Avoid treating a single successful fight as a universal ranking. The same notes also make it easier to spot whether a later update changed the card or only your other upgrades.

faq.question: Which powers are mentioned in the description?
faq.answer: Lightning, fire, frost, gravity, time, shadow and gold are named. The description also says there are more.

faq.question: How do you unlock a card’s strongest ability?
faq.answer: The developer description says to level up the card. It does not give a universal level requirement.

faq.question: Can cards earn cash?
faq.answer: Yes. The description says cards placed on base holders earn cash while you fight.

faq.question: What is confirmed about Ancient cards?
faq.answer: The creator mentions pulling an Ancient card. The source does not establish a full rarity order or any Ancient pull odds.

faq.question: What is the best power in Steal a Superpower?
faq.answer: This guide has no verified universal ranking. Compare the actual card, current level, unlocked moves and the fight you are preparing for rather than assigning a tier from its category name.

title: Steal a Superpower Bosses: Dominus & Progression Guide
description: Learn how Steal a Superpower bosses unlock new areas, loot chests and packs. Follow Dominus progression and the final-boss reference to Dominus Empyreus.

hero.heading: Steal a Superpower Bosses Guide
hero.lead: Steal a Superpower bosses gate the next area and connect combat to loot chests and packs. The developer description names Dominus Empyreus as the final boss.

sections.heading: What Are Dominus Bosses?
paragraphs: Dominus bosses are the progression fights named in the developer description. The stated objective is to fight through zones and defeat bosses to open the next area. This is the confirmed progression loop, rather than a complete boss-by-boss walkthrough.

subsections.heading: Bosses as Progression Gates
paragraphs: The stated reason to defeat a boss is to open the next area. If your goal is a new zone, focus on what the game shows before and after the boss fight. A general increase in cash or a new card is a different kind of progress and should not be mistaken for an area unlock.

subsections.heading: What Changes After Winning
paragraphs: Check the path to the next area and the available loot separately. This lets you distinguish an exploration result from a collection reward. The description does not set a universal player level, required damage number or reset schedule for these gates.

sections.heading: Boss Progression: Fight, Unlock, Collect
paragraphs: Use this sequence to understand what each successful boss fight is meant to advance. Exact interaction prompts and area requirements should be checked in the current game.

steps.heading: Fight through a zone
steps.description: Use the moves available on your power card against enemies as you progress toward the boss.

steps.heading: Defeat the boss
steps.description: The description says defeating bosses opens the next area. It does not list all bosses or their health.

steps.heading: Check the loot
steps.description: The stated reward loop includes loot chests and packs you can carry home. Inspect the actual reward in-game rather than assuming a particular pack or drop chance.

sections.heading: Boss Loot: Chests and Packs
paragraphs: Boss loot chests are part of the reward sequence described by the creator. The wording connects defeating bosses, cracking open their chests and carrying packs home. It does not identify a named pack for each boss, so there is no supported boss-to-pack drop table to memorize here.

After a fight, check what the game actually offers and record the pack name if one is shown. A pack reward is not the same as an already revealed power card: opening the pack belongs to the collection step. Keeping those steps separate helps you understand what a boss has awarded without guessing the card inside.

sections.heading: Dominus Empyreus
paragraphs: Dominus Empyreus is called the final boss in the description reproduced by the cited sources. That establishes its name and stated role, but does not establish its location, health, attack patterns or a reliable winning build.
If an update changes the available worlds or bosses, check the current game description before treating that designation as a complete endgame route.

sections.heading: Before Your Next Boss Attempt
paragraphs: Review the moves your card currently offers. Card leveling unlocks a stronger ability; upgrades, trails and auras are also described as boosting Power, Health and speed. These systems give you concrete things to inspect when progression stalls.

This is a preparation checklist, not a tested combat strategy: check your card level, available moves and the boosts actually shown by the game. No dodge timing, damage threshold or potion combination is assumed.

subsections.heading: Review Your Power Card
paragraphs: Check the card you are using and the moves it has unlocked. Leveling is confirmed to unlock the card’s most powerful ability, but the description does not give a shared required level. Review the actual card display before assuming you have its full moveset.

subsections.heading: Check Power, Health and Speed Systems
paragraphs: Inspect upgrades, trails and auras available in your current version. The description says these systems boost Power, Health and speed, but does not assign every item to a specific stat. Treat the displayed effects as information to review, not proof of an optimal purchase order.

sections.heading: Boss Rewards and Ability Packs
paragraphs: The developer text links boss victories to opening the next area, cracking loot chests and carrying packs home. Keep progression and collection separate when checking the result of a fight: an area unlock answers where you can go; a pack contributes to your card collection.

If you are deciding between another fight and developing a card, separate the question into two parts: do you understand your current moves, and is the next area still locked? The powers guide handles card development, while the packs guide handles further collection. These links continue the task without inventing a complete route through every zone.

links.label: See how pack rewards feed your collection

sections.heading: A Useful Boss-Attempt Checklist
paragraphs: Before retrying, note the boss name shown, your current card and unlocked moves, and any boosts visibly active. Afterward, note whether the next area opened and what reward was displayed. This is a way to organize your own observations; it is not evidence that the site has tested a fight.

Change one part of your preparation at a time when you want to understand a difference. A better result after changing both the card and several upgrades cannot establish which change helped. Avoid advice that gives exact health thresholds or attack timings without identifying the game version and showing the supporting fight.

links.label: Review the wider base, collection and upgrade systems

hero.heading: Steal a Superpower Packs Guide
hero.lead: Steal a Superpower packs are opened for power cards. Check the boss reward loop, media-reported code rewards and the developer’s advertised Legend Pack group offer.

sections.heading: What Do Ability Packs Do?
paragraphs: Opening an ability pack is how the developer description introduces collecting powers. The resulting cards have their own moves, and card leveling unlocks the strongest ability. A pack is the collection item; the card is what provides the moves.
That distinction helps when checking a reward: receiving a pack does not tell you which card you will pull. The cited description does not provide individual card drop tables.

subsections.heading: From Packs to Power Cards
paragraphs: An ability pack contributes to collecting cards. Inspect the card revealed when you open it before deciding whether it belongs in your combat setup or on a holder. The name of the pack alone does not establish the identity or stats of its contents.

subsections.heading: Cards and Movesets
paragraphs: The resulting cards have their own moves, and card leveling unlocks a stronger ability. Getting another pack and developing a card are separate activities. If your immediate question is about a move you already own, follow the power-card guide rather than assuming you need a different pack.

sections.heading: Free Legend Pack: The Group Offer
paragraphs: The reproduced developer description advertises a free Legend Pack for liking the game and joining the group. Start from the official Roblox experience to locate its creator community.

Those are the stated conditions in the description. It does not establish the claim button’s location, whether there is a cooldown, or whether an account can claim repeatedly. Follow any current instructions shown by the game; this guide does not promise a successful claim.

subsections.heading: Check the Offer Before Claiming
paragraphs: Read the current description on the official Roblox page first. Follow the creator community link from that page so you can identify the intended group. Like-and-join conditions come from the advertised offer; this guide does not replace them with a different community link.

subsections.heading: Check the Claim Result Separately
paragraphs: Meeting the described conditions and receiving the item are separate checks. Follow any claim instructions shown in your game and inspect the reward response or inventory result. The description does not establish a repeat-claim schedule, a cooldown or a guarantee for an account that has already claimed.

sections.heading: Packs from Codes
paragraphs: DISCORD is reported as a Legend Pack reward by Roblox Den and Pro Game Guides. Treat it as a dated report and confirm the claim inside the game. The code page includes the exact code, source, review date and copy action.
The other rewards recorded there are potions. Do not assume that every code opens a pack or that a potion is itself a pack.

Keep the group offer and the code claim separate even though both mention a Legend Pack. The former comes from the creator description; the latter is a media report about a redeemable string. One claim failing does not establish the status of the other, and this guide does not assume the rewards can be combined or claimed repeatedly.

sections.heading: From Packs to Progression
paragraphs: The supported loop is simple: open packs, collect cards, develop card moves, and use powers in combat. Bosses can lead back to more packs, while cards on base holders earn cash.

When choosing your next action, decide whether you need another card, more progress with your existing moves, or base income. That is a way to organize the described systems, rather than an untested best-pack recommendation.

For boss-earned packs, inspect the reward after the victory before planning around it. For a reported code, inspect the redemption response before assuming it added a pack. After opening a pack, inspect the resulting card. This short sequence separates three different confirmations that are easy to conflate: a claim succeeded, a pack was received, and a card was revealed.

sections.heading: Choosing Which Pack Route to Check
paragraphs: If you are already progressing through zones, the boss-and-chest loop is the route described alongside those fights. If you are reviewing a free reward, start with the current group offer or dated code report. These are different starting points, not a ranked list of fastest farming methods.

Use the game’s displayed conditions, reward names and results to compare your available options. The sources do not establish prices, drop percentages or the expected number of openings needed for an Ancient card. A claim about the best-value pack would need that information; none is implied by this source list.

faq.answer: The description advertises liking the game and joining its group. Check the current Roblox page and in-game instructions for the offer.

faq.answer: The cited sources do not establish a complete price list or drop-rate table. This guide does not assign guessed values.

title: Steal a Superpower Tier List: Best Powers & Cards
description: An evidence-first Steal a Superpower tier list: compare cards for combat, boss progress, and base cash without invented S-tier ratings or unverified stats.

hero.eyebrow: Independent Steal a Superpower Roblox guide
hero.heading: Steal a Superpower Tier List
hero.lead: Which Steal a Superpower card is best? There is no verified public card-by-card damage or cooldown ranking yet. Use this transparent comparison guide to choose what to test before investing in a power card.

sections.heading: Steal a Superpower Tier List: What Can Actually Be Ranked?
paragraphs: A reliable tier list must compare cards that players can actually identify and test. The official Roblox description confirms lightning, fire, frost, gravity, time, shadow and gold as examples of superpowers. It also says every card has its own moveset and leveling unlocks its most powerful ability. However, it does not supply the damage, attack speed, cooldowns or acquisition odds needed for an honest S-to-D ranking.

That means a list declaring lightning S-tier and gold B-tier today would be speculation, not a useful guide. This page separates verified systems from decisions you can make in your own game. It is deliberately different from the Powers guide, which documents the available types and how cards are leveled.

The fastest practical answer is to compare two cards in the same zone, with similar progression and the same upgrades, while recording how much they help your real goal. A card that clears the next boss for you may be more useful than a flashy card that you cannot level or consistently land.

sections.heading: Current Evidence and the Rating Standard
paragraphs: The creator describes cards and their upgrade loop, but no official tier chart is published in that description. Third-party rankings may be useful leads, yet an unsupported ordering should not be treated as an established fact. This guide does not convert rarity words into damage scores.

For every potential tier placement, check four things: a clearly named card; the game version or observation date; a comparable encounter; and a repeatable result. Without those, a letter grade would create false precision. An unknown value is not a weak card—it is simply a value that needs observation.

sections.heading: Compare Cards by the Task You Want to Complete
paragraphs: Instead of declaring a universal winner, pick the single task you care about: fighting regular enemies, defeating a Dominus boss, farming packs, or earning passive cash. The same card could be strong for one task and mediocre for another, so comparisons should not mix different objectives.

If two powers look close, compare how reliably you can land the moves rather than relying on a one-off large hit. For boss attempts, the practical question is whether you survive and finish the encounter. For cash generation, the holder's actual displayed output matters more than combat animation. The public description does not establish that combat ranking and base income ranking are identical.

sections.heading: How to Make a Personal Tier List in Game
paragraphs: Start by writing down the exact names of cards you own. Keep the same zone, boss and upgrade level when comparing two candidates. Record the moves you actually used, how long the fight took and whether the run succeeded. Do two or more trials before concluding one card is consistently better.

Next, note any change when you level a card and unlock a stronger ability. Testing a level-one card against a fully developed card only measures your progression gap; it does not settle which card is inherently better. If you use potions, trails or auras, record them because the developer explicitly lists those systems as ways to improve Power, Health and speed.

Finally, keep a separate base-income column. Cards placed on holders produce cash while you fight. You can compare the holder values shown to you, but do not publish made-up per-second rates. An honest local comparison helps you choose a card now and leaves room for the game to change later.

sections.heading: Is Ancient Automatically the Best Power?
paragraphs: The official description challenges players to pull an Ancient card and defeat Dominus Empyreus, the final boss. Ancient is therefore a meaningful collection milestone, but the description does not reveal every Ancient card's statistics or guarantee that every Ancient pull outperforms every other card in all situations.

Likewise, a free Legend Pack is explicitly mentioned as a reward for liking the game and joining the group. The pack's name is not a reliable combat ranking for its contents. Do not confuse the probability of acquiring a rarity with the performance of an individual card after you obtain it.

Use the Index as a separate collection goal. Completing rarities is associated with permanent rewards according to the developer, but an Index milestone is not a controlled test of damage. For the acquisition routes, check the Packs guide rather than guessing a pack-to-card table.

sections.heading: When Will This Tier List Have S, A and B Rankings?
paragraphs: A defensible public letter-grade list needs repeatable card comparisons or official data. Until those exist, this page keeps the ranking status explicit: no independently verified S/A/B/C placements are asserted. An absent rating should never be interpreted as a zero or bad rank.

The developer can rebalance cards, add areas or change a moveset. If you test your collection, keep a date, the card name and the actual outcome together. That evidence is more useful than presenting an invented tier chart. This page was reviewed on the date shown above for the official mechanics and public evidence, not through a direct play-session benchmark.

paragraphs: Start with what you want to solve. If you are looking for a reported reward, the Codes page is the right place. If you need to unlock an area, use the boss guide. The powers and packs pages cover different sides of the same system: cards are collected from packs and then used in combat or placed in your base.

This is an independent fan-made resource and is not the official Roblox website or a developer-operated wiki. It identifies the game by its official Roblox Place ID 74183246285569 so you do not accidentally follow advice for another similarly named stealing or power game.

sections.heading: What Game Does This Wiki Cover?
paragraphs: Steal a Superpower! is a Roblox experience by 11 R$ Productions. The official description introduces ability packs, collectible powers and Dominus bosses. The gameplay loop is both a fighting game and a collecting/base-building game: what you equip changes combat, while what you place on holders adds income.

The official page lists lightning, fire, frost, gravity, time, shadow and gold among the available power themes and adds 'and more.' These are examples from the creator, not a promise that this wiki has every current card name. The same description names Dominus Empyreus as the final boss. The live game can change, so dated source-backed information is preferable to a guessed exhaustive database.
The game itself should be launched on Roblox. Our guides do not host the executable, ask for your account password, redeem codes on your behalf or claim any connection to the development team.

sections.heading: The Core Gameplay Loop
paragraphs: Open an ability pack to get a power card. Each card has its own moves, and leveling is described as unlocking its strongest ability. The player fights enemies across zones and defeats Dominus bosses to open subsequent areas. Boss loot chests and packs provide more opportunities to grow a collection.

The second half of the loop happens at your base. Putting cards on holders allows them to earn cash while you continue fighting. That means the best choice for your current battle is not necessarily the best card to leave on a holder. In addition, upgrades, trails and auras can improve Power, Health and speed.

The game also features kill streaks that provide multipliers and critical hits, an Index with permanent rewards for collecting rarities, and leaderboards for Top Cash and Top Power. These mechanics overlap, but each answers a different player question.

sections.heading: Powers, Card Levels and Rarity
paragraphs: Choose a power by the move set it gives you and the task you are facing. A card can improve as you level it; however, exact move unlock thresholds are not stated by the developer description. Read the values in your own game when making upgrade decisions instead of trusting a generic 'max level' claim copied from another title.

The game mentions an Ancient card as an aspirational pull. The Index is tied to rarities collected, but the official description does not publish a complete rarity ladder, numerical drop rates or a full item roster. A useful wiki should distinguish named facts from missing data, so our Powers page deliberately does not fill those cells with invented values.
Our Tier List page explains how to evaluate battle effectiveness, boss progression and passive income separately. It does not assign unverified letter rankings simply to make a table look complete.

sections.heading: Bosses, Packs and New Zones
paragraphs: Defeating a Dominus boss matters because it opens the next area, and the official text associates boss victories with loot chests and the ability to bring packs home. It does not provide an exact boss order or a guaranteed chest-to-card reward chart.

The source-backed Bosses page keeps that distinction clear. For preparing to fight, look at the card you are actually using, whether its best move is available and whether the upgrade, trail or aura systems shown in the game can help. Do not mistake the official name of the final boss for a complete route.

Packs can be earned through progression and some reported codes. The creator also advertises a free Legend Pack to players who like the game and join the group. Check the precise requirements in Roblox; third-party guides should not collect login details or promise rewards that they cannot verify.

If you play in Thai, a dedicated Thai guide provides the same reported code strings with Thai instructions and a direct link back to English.

Some publicly discussed gameplay screenshots show UI buttons labelled Merge 2 and Merge 4. Those labels are useful evidence that a merging-related control exists, but they do not establish the required duplicates, the outcome or the conditions for use. The focused Merge guide identifies what is visible and how to inspect your current game UI safely without pretending to have an official fusion recipe.

sections.heading: What Should a New Player Do First?
paragraphs: First, check any available packs and the powers you own. Equip a card you can use comfortably, learn its moves and review the leveling information. Work toward the next zone by fighting enemies and the boss that gates access. When you gain additional cards, consider the base-income use of holders as well as the combat use of the equipped card.

If a fight becomes difficult, review the upgrading systems before assuming you need a different element. The official developer description explicitly names upgrades, trails, auras, critical hits and kill-streak bonuses as sources of progress. It does not give a universal spending order, so inspect your own costs and effects.

After a successful boss attempt, collect the rewards available in the game and check whether the new area opened. Then return to the relevant focused guide instead of relying on a long generalized walkthrough. This wiki exists to make those next steps easy to find.

hero.eyebrow: Independent Steal a Superpower Roblox guide
hero.heading: How to Merge in Steal a Superpower (Roblox Guide)
hero.lead: Looking for the merge controls in Steal a Superpower? Public gameplay captures show Merge 2 and Merge 4 buttons, but no reliable official recipe or result chart has been published. Here is what you can safely check in your own game.

sections.heading: How to Merge in Steal a Superpower
paragraphs: Two pieces of external gameplay evidence show merging-related controls: a public gameplay HUD walkthrough describes Merge 2 and Merge 4 buttons on the lower action bar, and a separately compiled wiki reports the same labels in both a screenshot and a gameplay video. These observations are about the Roblox experience at Place ID 74183246285569, not another 'steal a power' game.

That establishes a visible place to start looking; it does not establish what cards a merge consumes, whether it needs duplicates, what exact result appears or whether every account sees the same options. The developer's official description talks about collecting and leveling power cards but does not explain the merge recipe. Avoid any guide that quietly invents a two-card or four-card formula from the button labels alone.

If you cannot see Merge 2 or Merge 4 in your current client, check the full action bar and your collection screens. Updates, UI scaling and the state of your account can affect what is visible. This page does not guarantee a button will be available on every build.

sections.heading: Find the Merge Controls Without Guessing a Recipe
paragraphs: Open the correct official Roblox game and allow its interface to load. A third-party screenshot comparison places the merge controls around the bottom HUD alongside the normal action controls. On a narrow phone display, inspect the complete lower bar rather than assuming a card menu has the same layout as a desktop screenshot.

Before pressing a merge button, inspect the cards in your collection and note which ones are equipped or earning cash on holders. Look at any confirmation UI presented by the live game. If the interface does not specify which cards or quantities are required, do not infer the cost from the button name.

If a merge operation is offered, read its actual preview and on-screen confirmation before you approve it. Afterwards, inspect your collection and base again to see what changed. This is a verification process for your own save, not a claim that a particular ingredient count, rarity upgrade or stat increase has been tested here.

sections.heading: What the Merge 2 and Merge 4 Labels Do — and Do Not — Prove
paragraphs: The labels are visual evidence of a merge-related action, not proof of a complete crafting system. In particular, the numeral in Merge 2 cannot be treated as an official requirement to spend two duplicates without an in-game explanation or confirmed footage of that transaction.

Automated-script promotional pages also refer to 'Auto Merge' or 'Merge Duplicate Cards.' Those third-party automation descriptions are not official tutorials, do not confirm a stable game mechanic and are not instructions we recommend running. An external script can carry account and device risk and should not be necessary to learn how to use the ordinary game interface.
The facts listed below are deliberately separated so you can tell what needs to be checked when you play.

sections.heading: What to Check Before You Merge
paragraphs: First, identify the card you actively use in combat. Because leveling unlocks its strongest move, an accidentally lost or altered favorite could affect your current progression. Second, review the cards earning cash on base holders: they have a different role from the equipped power and may be useful even if they are not your strongest fighters.

Third, pay attention to the Index. The game description ties permanent rewards to collecting different rarities, but it does not say a merge improves Index progress. Keep track of your collection before and after an operation rather than assuming an upgraded card automatically counts as a new rarity.

Finally, remember that Roblox games change. If a screen you see today contradicts a November screenshot, the current game's labels and confirmation are more relevant than an older guide. Never enter your Roblox login details into a third-party merging calculator.

sections.heading: Why Is the Merge Button Missing or Not Responding?
paragraphs: If you cannot find a merge button, check whether the action bar is collapsed or partly outside the visible mobile viewport. On desktop, look for the lower action controls described in public screenshots. A screenshot from a different Roblox title is not a reliable map for this experience.

If the control is disabled, the game may be asking for an unmet condition, but the currently available official description does not specify one. Read the on-screen explanation, if any, and inspect your current collection. Do not make repeated irreversible attempts simply because a guide guessed a required ingredient.

If an operation appears to work but the result is unclear, check the collection, equipped card and holder setup. If your display or inventory has not refreshed, the safest action is to verify in the normal Roblox interface rather than downloading an unauthorized script.

sections.heading: Sources and What Remains Unverified
paragraphs: The official Roblox experience description confirms collectible powers, card leveling, packs and holders. The independent gameplay sources report the Merge 2 / Merge 4 HUD labels. Neither provides a step-by-step official recipe, verified ingredient count, success rate, new rarity rule or a recorded before-and-after transaction.

Therefore this is a control-finding and safe-verification guide, not a fabricated merge recipe. It will be updated when credible gameplay captures or official information show a complete operation. The current review date identifies the sources checked, not an in-game merge test.

faq.question: Where is the merge button in Steal a Superpower?
faq.answer: Independent gameplay screenshots report Merge 2 and Merge 4 buttons around the bottom action bar. Confirm their current location inside the live game.

faq.question: Do I need two or four duplicate cards?
faq.answer: The labels alone do not establish ingredient requirements. Read the live game's requirement or confirmation.

faq.question: Can merging create an Ancient card?
faq.answer: No credible source reviewed here establishes that outcome or its probability.

faq.question: Should I use an Auto Merge script?
faq.answer: No. Use the ordinary Roblox interface; third-party executors are not required by any verified official source.

sections.heading: ของรางวัลจากโค้ดมีอะไรบ้าง?
paragraphs: รายการที่อ้างอิงจากหน้ารวมโค้ดภาษาอังกฤษของเราแสดงรางวัลที่มีการรายงาน เช่น Luck Potion, Power Potion และ Legend Pack อย่างไรก็ตาม รายการของรางวัลเหล่านี้ยังไม่ได้ผ่านการทดสอบด้วยบัญชีเกมของเราในวันที่ตรวจทาน

โพชันและแพ็กทำหน้าที่ต่างกันตามชื่อและคำอธิบายที่แหล่งข้อมูลเผยแพร่ แพ็กเกี่ยวข้องกับการสะสมการ์ด ส่วนตัวเกมอธิบายว่าการ์ดแต่ละใบมีท่าโจมตีของตนเองและสามารถเพิ่มเลเวลเพื่อปลดล็อกท่าที่ทรงพลังขึ้น อย่าตีความว่าโค้ดหนึ่งรายการรับประกันว่าจะได้การ์ดหายาก
ผู้พัฒนายังประกาศข้อเสนอแพ็ก Legend ฟรีสำหรับการกดถูกใจเกมและเข้าร่วมกลุ่มใน Roblox ซึ่งเป็นคนละเรื่องกับการกรอกรหัส ควรอ่านเงื่อนไขบนหน้าจอเกมจริงก่อนทำตาม

sections.heading: แหล่งข้อมูลและวันที่ตรวจสอบ
paragraphs: เราแสดงโค้ดจากหน้าภาษาอังกฤษของเว็บไซต์เดิม ซึ่งมีบันทึกแหล่งข้อมูลและวันที่ตรวจทาน 5 พฤศจิกายน 2026 การเผยแพร่บทความภาษาไทยในวันที่ใหม่กว่าไม่ได้หมายความว่ารหัสทุกตัวได้รับการทดสอบใหม่ในวันนั้น

หากคุณต้องการดูข้อความภาษาอังกฤษ รางวัลตามที่แหล่งข้อมูลรายงาน และลิงก์ต้นทาง โปรดเปิดหน้ารวม Codes ภาษาอังกฤษได้โดยตรง เนื้อหาภาษาไทยนี้ทำขึ้นเพื่อช่วยให้ผู้เล่นเข้าใจขั้นตอนและข้อจำกัด ไม่ใช่การรับประกันของรางวัล
เว็บไซต์นี้เป็นคู่มือแฟนเกมอิสระ ไม่เกี่ยวข้องกับ Roblox หรือผู้พัฒนาเกม ไม่ขอรหัสผ่าน ไม่สามารถแลกรางวัลแทนผู้เล่น และไม่ควรใช้เป็นแหล่งยืนยันสถานะโค้ดแบบทันที

sections.heading: เปิดเกม Steal a Superpower อย่างปลอดภัย
paragraphs: การแลกรหัสทั้งหมดต้องทำใน Roblox โดยใช้เกมที่ถูกต้องตามหมายเลข Place ID 74183246285569 หากมีข้อความเชิญให้ลงชื่อเข้าใช้จากหน้าเว็บที่ไม่ใช่ Roblox หรือขอข้อมูลบัญชีเพื่อแลกโค้ด ควรหยุดก่อนและกลับไปใช้ช่องกรอกในเกม
ผู้เล่นสามารถศึกษาระบบพลัง บอส และแพ็กจากคู่มืออื่นของเว็บไซต์ แล้วกลับมาใช้โค้ดที่มีแหล่งข้อมูลอ้างอิงได้ตามต้องการ ตรวจสอบสถานะในเกมเสมอเพราะข้อมูลการแลกรางวัลเปลี่ยนได้ตลอดเวลา

faq.question: โค้ด Steal a Superpower ใช้ได้แน่นอนหรือไม่?
faq.answer: ไม่สามารถรับประกันได้ รายการนี้รวบรวมรหัสที่มีรายงานจากเว็บไซต์ภายนอกและยังไม่ได้ทดสอบแลกจริงในเกม ณ วันนี้

faq.question: ต้องกรอกโค้ดที่เว็บไซต์นี้หรือไม่?
faq.answer: ไม่ต้องกรอกที่เว็บไซต์นี้ ให้เปิด Roblox แล้วใช้เมนู Codes ภายในเกมเท่านั้น

faq.question: ทำไมแลกโค้ดแล้วไม่สำเร็จ?
faq.answer: รหัสอาจหมดอายุ เคยใช้แล้ว หรือคัดลอกผิด ตรวจสอบข้อความในเกมและรายละเอียดของรหัสอีกครั้ง

faq.question: สามารถอ่านคู่มือภาษาอังกฤษได้ที่ไหน?
faq.answer: เปิดหน้า Codes ภาษาอังกฤษผ่านลิงก์ด้านบนเพื่อดูรายการต้นฉบับและแหล่งข้อมูลที่อ้างอิง
